# Third-party Source Drops

This directory contains external source snapshots used for evaluation or local adaptation.

## staticpages

- Upstream: https://github.com/SpechtLabs/StaticPages
- Snapshot: `ea5858cf0cd30db4f0a1b605cbbc8027e0515471`
- License: Apache-2.0
- Local path: `third_party/staticpages`

The upstream `.git` directory is intentionally not vendored, so the monorepo remains a single Git repository.
